progression.narrative: The performance opens on Fs4 and dwells most on G in Mehdi Zarrabi. The line peaks at A4 (437.3 Hz) at 0:02.3. It closes on E3, not the tonic (G3 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E3).
